title: Query Builder Basics
objectives: `DB::table()` se select, insert, update, delete karna
SQL injection se bachav (parameter binding) samajhna
`paginate()` aur transactions ka basic use jaanna

sections.heading: Query Builder kya hai?
sections.body: Query Builder SQL ko PHP method chain mein likhne ka tareeka hai. Tum `DB::table('products')->where(...)->get()` likhte ho, aur Laravel sahi SQL bana kar chalata hai. Isme **PDO parameter binding** hoti hai, isliye SQL injection se bachav milta hai. Eloquent ORM (agla module) isi ke upar bana hai.

callout.text: Pehle query builder samjho. Eloquent mein bhi jab model methods se kaam nahi chalta, to isi tarah ki chaining use hoti hai.

sections.heading: Select: data padhna
sections.body: `get()` collection deta hai, `first()` ek row, `find()` primary key se.
explain: `where('price', '<', 500)` – column, operator, value. Do argument ho to `=` maan liya jaata hai.
`get()` – `Collection` jisme har row `stdClass` object hoti hai.

sections.heading: Insert, update, delete
sections.body: Query builder `created_at`/`updated_at` apne aap nahi bharta, Eloquent bharta hai.

callout.text: `update` ya `delete` mein `where` lagana mat bhoolo, warna poori table ki rows badal/delete ho jaayengi.

sections.heading: Aggregates aur join
sections.body: Count, sum, average aur do tables ko jodna:
explain: `join(table, left, operator, right)` – do tables jodta hai.
`select('categories.name as category')` – column ko alias dete hain.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Products page with pagination
sections.body: Controller mein query builder, aur Blade mein `links()` se pages.
explain: `paginate(10)` – 10 rows per page aur `?page=2` ko khud sambhalta hai.

sections.heading: Raw SQL aur transactions
sections.body: Kabhi raw SQL chahiye ho to **hamesha bindings** use karo. Kai queries ko ek saath safe chalane ke liye transaction.
explain: `?` placeholder aur array se values safe jaati hain.
`DB::transaction()` – andar ki koi query fail ho to sab undo.
`->dd()` – query builder ki SQL aur bindings dikhata hai (debugging).
`decrement('stock', 1)` – column ko ek se kam karta hai.

versionDiff.heading: Query Builder: Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: Query Builder ka syntax teeno versions mein same hai.

items.13: Same as 11. Naye helper methods ke liye official Query Builder docs dekho.

errors.error: SQLSTATE[42S22]: Column not found: 1054 Unknown column 'x' in 'where clause'
errors.cause: Column ka naam table se match nahi karta (ya migration nahi chali).
errors.fix: `db:table products` se columns dekho aur spelling theek karo.

errors.error: Trying to get property 'name' of non-object
errors.cause: `first()` ne null diya (row nahi mili) aur tumne use seedha padha.
errors.fix: Pehle check karo: `if ($row) {...}`, ya `firstOrFail()` jaisa method use karo.
Hamesha `where` lagao, aur pehle `select` se rows check karo.

debug.body: Query ki asli SQL dekhne ke liye `toSql()` ya `dd()`.

tasks: 500 se mehnge products price ke hisaab se descending nikalo
`/products` page banao jo `paginate(10)` se products dikhaye

quiz.q: SQL injection se bachne ke liye kya karna chahiye?
quiz.why: Bindings (`?` placeholder) values ko SQL se alag rakhte hain.

quiz.q: Query builder `created_at` apne aap bharta hai?
quiz.why: Timestamps apne aap Eloquent bharta hai, query builder nahi.

interview.q: Query Builder aur Eloquent mein farak?
interview.a: Query builder table par SQL-jaisi chaining deta hai aur stdClass rows lata hai. Eloquent models ke saath kaam karta hai aur relationships, timestamps jaise features deta hai.
`get()` saari matching rows ka collection, `first()` sirf pehli row (ya null).

interview.q: Query Builder SQL injection se kaise bachata hai?
interview.a: PDO parameter binding se: values query string mein nahi, alag bheji jaati hain.
Jab kai queries ek saath safe chalani hon: ek fail ho to sab undo ho jaaye.
Results ko pages mein baantta hai aur view ke liye `links()` ke saath page numbers deta hai.

summary: `DB::table()` se SQL ko method chain mein likhte hain.
Bindings se SQL injection se bachav.
`paginate()` aur `DB::transaction()` real projects mein kaam aate hain.
